sessionStart.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event ready >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event working >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'

preToolUse.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event waiting >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'

postToolUse.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event working >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'

postToolUseFailure.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event working >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'

stop.command: ringframe sessions turn --from-hook --host cursor --event turn_ended >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'
